en.askTitle: Put in your own dates, budget and drivers to get a Tasmania road trip with the costs and drive times checked
en.runTitle: Melbourne to Tasmania: five gentle days for two on about AUD 2,600

fields.label: Travellers and walking comfort
fields.value: A couple from Melbourne; easy-to-moderate walks

fields.label: Dates and flight times
fields.value: Fly into Hobart Fri 19 Feb 2027, out of Launceston Wed 24 Feb 2027

fields.label: Budget, with or without flights
fields.value: About AUD 2,600 for two, excluding flights

fields.label: Room quotes you already have
fields.placeholder: e.g. Hobart, 3 nights at AUD 190 a night

fields.label: Driver ages, licence documents and experience
fields.placeholder: e.g. two drivers aged 30 and 32, Australian licences, comfortable on country roads

fields.label: Rental pickup and return times
fields.placeholder: e.g. pick up 11:00 at Hobart Airport, return by 11:00 at Launceston Airport

en.template: Plan a gentle Tasmania trip for {travellers} on {dates}, with {budget}, {rooms}, {drivers} and {pickup}. Compare Hobart, the Tasman Peninsula, Swansea, Freycinet and Launceston without Cradle Mountain's long detour. Check complete room/car costs, park passes, weather alternatives and uphill walking limits. Plan only; do not book, sign up, contact suppliers or pay.

phases.title: Check official entry prices, drive times, places to stay and rental-car costs
phases.note: Park pass, MONA, Port Arthur, Wineglass Bay, one-way car hire
phases.judgment: It caught a price trap before budgeting: Swansea Motor Inn advertises a room from $125, but the same booking grid showed $322 for the 22 February night, so it did not budget $125. It also ruled out Cradle Mountain as a side trip: about 2 h 56 min and 259 km more driving.

phases.title: Build the day-by-day itinerary and a budget that adds up, with source notes
phases.note: An independent check of the dates, sums and route came along the way
phases.judgment: The independent colleague recalculated the budget (AUD 2,466.35 plus a 133.65 buffer makes 2,600) and said plainly that the room prices are undated “from” rates that cannot prove the trip fits AUD 2,600. The plan is therefore labelled conditional, not guaranteed.

phases.title: Final check of both files and saving them in the folder

workers: Collected driving times for every leg from a named route planner, weighed up the Cradle Mountain detour, and checked car-rental costs including the one-way fee
Found six places to stay across Hobart, Swansea and Launceston, with the prices they publish and what each price does and doesn’t cover
Independently checked the finished itinerary for dates, sums and whether the route is realistic

zh.askTitle: 填上你自己的日期、预算和驾驶员，得到一份花费和车程都核对过的塔斯马尼亚自驾行程
zh.runTitle: 墨尔本出发：两人塔斯马尼亚五天轻松游，预算约 2,600 澳元

fields.label: 旅客人数和步行体力
fields.value: 来自墨尔本的一对夫妻；轻松到中等强度的步道

fields.label: 日期及航班时间
fields.value: 2027 年 2 月 19 日（周五）飞抵霍巴特，2 月 24 日（周三）从朗塞斯顿离开

fields.label: 预算金额及是否含机票
fields.value: 两人约 2,600 澳元，不含机票

fields.label: 已有的房间报价
fields.placeholder: 例如：霍巴特 3 晚，每晚 190 澳元

fields.label: 驾驶员年龄、驾照证件和经验
fields.placeholder: 例如：两位驾驶员 30 岁和 32 岁，持澳大利亚驾照，熟悉乡间道路

fields.label: 取还车时间
fields.placeholder: 例如：11:00 在霍巴特机场取车，次日 11:00 前在朗塞斯顿机场还车

zh.template: 请为{travellers}规划{dates}的轻松塔斯马尼亚旅行，预算{budget}，房间报价{rooms}，驾驶员{drivers}，取还车时间{pickup}。比较霍巴特、塔斯曼半岛、斯旺西、Freycinet 和朗塞斯顿，不加摇篮山长途绕行。核对住宿与租车全价、公园通票、天气替代和上坡步道限制。只做计划；不要预订、注册、联系供应商或付款。

phases.title: 核对官方门票价格、车程、住处和租车费用
phases.note: 国家公园通票、MONA、亚瑟港、酒杯湾、异地租车
phases.judgment: 编预算前先识破了一个价格陷阱：斯旺西 Swansea Motor Inn 标着房价 125 澳元起，但同一份订房日历里 2 月 22 日那晚显示 322 澳元，所以没有按 125 澳元做预算。它还否掉了摇篮山这个顺路点：要多开约 2 小时 56 分钟、259 公里。

phases.title: 做出逐日行程和加得起来的预算，并附来源说明
phases.note: 途中有一位同事独立检查了日期、金额和路线
phases.judgment: 独立检查的同事重算了预算（2,466.35 澳元加 133.65 澳元缓冲，正好 2,600 澳元），并直说住宿价格是没标日期的“起价”，不能证明这趟行程真能控制在 2,600 澳元内，所以计划标注为“有条件”，而不是保证。

phases.title: 最后检查两份文件，并存到指定文件夹

workers: 用指定的路线规划网站查了每一段路的车程，比较了摇篮山绕行的代价，并核对租车费用，包括异地还车费
在霍巴特、斯旺西和朗塞斯顿找了六个住处，记下它们公布的价格以及每个价格包含和不包含什么
独立检查成稿，核对日期、金额，以及路线是否现实
